scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: D range and sum
checks.code: import std.stdio; void main() { int total=0; foreach(n;1..11) total+=n; writeln(total); }

checks.name: D template function
checks.code: import std.stdio; T square(T)(T n) { return n*n; } void main() { writeln(square(7)); }

checks.name: D compile-time expression and Phobos
checks.code: import std.stdio; import std.algorithm; import std.range; enum value=6*7; void main() { writeln(value); writeln([1,2,3,4].map!(n => n*n).sum); }

checks.name: D multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: import std.stdio; import std.string; void main() { foreach(_;0..2) writeln("[",readln().strip(),"]"); }

checks.name: D type error prevents execution
checks.code: import std.stdio; void main() { writeln("MUST_NOT_RUN"); int n="wrong"; writeln(n); }

checks.name: D unhandled exception fails
checks.code: void main() { throw new Exception("intentional error"); }

checks.name: D handled exception succeeds
checks.code: import std.stdio; void main() { try { throw new Exception("expected"); } catch(Exception e) { writeln("handled"); } }
